name: @spiritsurge/figma-mcp

tools.name: clone_node
tools.description: Duplicate a node with all its children, styles and effects intact, optionally at a new position. Returns the copy's subtree — the copies have new ids. Use this rather than rebuilding a design from its parts. This modifies the document.

depth.description:
Levels of the copy's subtree to return. Defaults to 2, which is enough
to address the copy's direct children.

name.description: Layer name for the copy. Defaults to Figma's own "name (Copy)".

x.description: Where to put the copy. Omit either to leave it on top of the original.

tools.name: create_image
tools.description: Place an image file from this machine onto the current Figma page as a new layer. This modifies the document.

name.description: Layer name. Defaults to the file's own name.

path.description: Absolute path to a PNG or JPEG on this machine.

width.description: Displayed size. Defaults to the image's own pixel dimensions.

x.description: Position on the current page, in Figma canvas coordinates.

tools.name: delete_nodes
tools.description: Delete nodes by id. Ids that no longer exist are reported rather than failing the call. This modifies the document.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read the structure of the open Figma document as a node tree. Prefer a depth limit or get_node on a specific frame; a whole large file can be tens of megabytes.

depth.description:
How many levels of the node tree to include. Omit for the whole tree,
which on a large file can be very large indeed.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Read file name, current page and selection count. Cheap; useful as a first call to confirm which file is open.

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Read one node and its subtree by id. This is the right tool for inspecting a specific frame or component.

node_id.description: Figma node id, as it appears in a file URL, e.g. "1:23".

tools.name: get_pages
tools.description: List the pages in the open document.

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Render a node or the current page to a base64 PNG. Use when the visual result matters more than the structure.

node_id.description: Node to render. Omit to render the current page.

scale.description: Render scale; 1.0 is the design's own size. Defaults to 2.0.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Read the nodes the user currently has selected in Figma. Use this when the user refers to 'this' or 'the selected frame'.

tools.name: get_styles
tools.description: Read the document's local paint, text, effect and grid styles — the design system's named values.

tools.name: get_variable_defs
tools.description: Read the document's variable collections and their values across modes — design tokens, in Figma's terms.

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Replace the contents of a text node, keeping its font, size, colour and effects. Returns the previous text and the node's new size. This modifies the document.

characters.description: The new contents. May be empty.

instructions:
Reads the Figma document currently open in the desktop or web app, through a plugin the user runs and connects.

If a tool reports that no plugin is connected, tell the user to open the plugin in Figma and select this session — it is not something you can fix by retrying.

Start with get_metadata to confirm which file is open. Prefer get_selection or get_node over get_document: whole-document reads on a real file are very large.
